xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5598: Order books: every action available from pan orders and as MCP tools

plan.title: Order books: every action available from pan orders and as MCP tools
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Parity across three surfaces is one feature, and repo sync tests force co-change across subsystems: every ROUTE_SCOPES path must appear in packages/contracts telemetry and docs/TELEMETRY.md (route-scopes.test.ts, telemetry-docs.test.ts), and every MCP tool name must appear in the telemetry domain (mcp-domains.test.ts). The plan stays at 25 files and its items are small vertical slices; splitting into sibling issues would leave each sibling red on those sync tests or ship a half-parity surface.

narratives.Problem: The Order books dashboard page can rename a book, set its parallel limit and extra-instructions file, pause or resume pickup, edit an issue's options, show blocking problems, preview the brief and list backlog candidates. pan orders can do none of these, the Overdeck MCP server has no order-book tools, and the /api/orders* routes have no ROUTE_SCOPES rows, so an agent token (never admin) cannot call them. Even with a scope row, an MCP DELETE fails the route's Content-Type check because both MCP clients omit the header on DELETE.
narratives.Proposal: Add ROUTE_SCOPES rows for all ten /api/orders routes (reads read:state, writes operate) and their telemetry client-route paths. Make both MCP clients send JSON on a DELETE that carries a body. Add ten MCP tools in src/lib/mcp/tools-orders.ts that proxy the existing routes, with a route-coverage test. Add pan orders rename, set, pause, resume, item, preview, candidates and check in a new src/cli/commands/orders-edit.ts (check reads validation through callDashboard with the CLI-resolved project key), plus --prereqs/--plan-at-pickup on add and --json on list/show. Move previewBrief to src/lib/orders/brief.ts so the CLI and route share it. Document every verb and tool and add a three-way parity table.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new HTTP routes and no no-loss-matrix rows.
- No change to rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest or any other auth helper.
- No pan orders unqueue, archive or unarchive (PAN-5597 owns them).
- No change to which book dispatch treats as active (PAN-5599).
- pan orders queue and pan orders start do not gain validation.
- Route writes (dashboard page and MCP tools) stay uncommitted; no commit logic is added to the routes.
- The route's laneAConcurrency validation is not narrowed to 1-8.
- No public-MCP or connector allowlist changes; the token's scope decides, as for start_issue.
- No edits to PAN-5597-owned paragraphs in configuration/order-books.mdx beyond the two sentence fixes and the new section.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix MCP DELETE by sending JSON and Content-Type when a DELETE carries a body, in both MCP clients; remove_order_book_issue passes {}.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the auth helper and every existing bodyless DELETE tool unchanged, and makes the remove tool work over /mcp, pan mcp serve and the connector.

autoDecisions.summary: pan orders check calls GET /api/orders/:id through callDashboard with ?project=<key> resolved on the CLI side.
autoDecisions.rationale: callDashboard carries the internal token; without the key the route resolves the dashboard process's cwd project rather than the operator's.

autoDecisions.summary: Order-book MCP tools are audience any, and visible through the public funnel and the connector by scope like start_issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The route-scope table is the one authority (PAN-4649 D-21); no special casing is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Parallel limit is validated as 1 to 8 in the MCP tool and the CLI; the route is not changed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the dashboard stepper (LANE_A_MAX = 8) without changing route semantics PAN-5597 also edits.

autoDecisions.summary: update_order_book passes status ready/draft/complete through to the route (PRD D5), and the docs parity table uses checkpoint CP-2 wording when PAN-5597 has not merged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The route decides what is allowed; the docs stay true whichever branch merges first.

autoDecisions.summary: All new CLI verbs live in src/cli/commands/orders-edit.ts with one test file, built serially across three items.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the PAN-5597 overlap in orders.ts to one import and one call, and stays within the 25-file plan limit.
